title: Using Astra 6 to build my dream game
author: editor22uk
selftext:
So for years I have been developing this futuristic world in my mind where humanity lives inside massive mega cities controlled by corporations and the outside world just kind of falls to ruin.   
  
I have loved city management, crafting and high level RNG games all my life so why not combine them all into what is my dream game!

This has taken around 3 days of codex Astra usage so far to dial in the mechanics and a game loop but its working and I have already sunk plenty of hours into actually playing it rather than developing!
